# stalwart_sieve_user_interpreter (Data Source)

Configures the user-level Sieve script interpreter settings and limits. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `allowed_notify_uris` (Set of String) List of allowed URIs for the notify extension
- `default_expiry_duplicate` (Number) Default expiration time for IDs stored by the duplicate extension from user scripts
- `default_expiry_vacation` (Number) Default expiration time for IDs stored by the vacation extension
- `default_subject` (String) Default subject of vacation responses
- `default_subject_prefix` (String) Default subject prefix of vacation responses
- `disable_capabilities` (Set of String) List of capabilities to disable in the user interpreter
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `max_cpu_cycles` (Number) Maximum number CPU cycles a script can use
- `max_header_size` (Number) Maximum size of a header
- `max_includes` (Number) Maximum number of includes
- `max_local_vars` (Number) Maximum number of local variables
- `max_match_vars` (Number) Maximum number of match variables
- `max_nested_blocks` (Number) Maximum number of nested blocks
- `max_nested_for_every` (Number) Maximum number of nested foreach blocks
- `max_nested_includes` (Number) Maximum number of nested includes
- `max_nested_tests` (Number) Maximum number of nested tests
- `max_out_messages` (Number) Maximum number of outgoing messages
- `max_received_headers` (Number) Maximum number of received headers
- `max_redirects` (Number) Maximum number of redirects
- `max_script_name_length` (Number) Maximum length of a script name
- `max_script_size` (Number) Maximum size of a script
- `max_scripts` (Number) The default maximum number of sieve scripts a user can create
- `max_string_length` (Number) Maximum length of a string
- `max_var_name_length` (Number) Maximum length of a variable name
- `max_var_size` (Number) Maximum size of a variable
- `protected_headers` (Set of String) List of headers that cannot be deleted or added using the editheader extension
